Title: use Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(ui): show labels`.

If the change breaks user-visible behavior (accepted flags, key bindings,
the layout of timeline rows or `-dump` output, which pull requests and
issues are followed), add `!` after the type or scope, e.g.
`feat(ui)!: drop the time column`. The `breaking-change` label is then
added automatically, and the release notes list the PR under
"Breaking changes". If you forgot the `!`, fix the title or add the label
by hand.

A breaking change also needs an entry in CHANGES.md: the old behavior, the
new behavior and how to migrate.
